technical_data.additional_notes: Email passed SPF, DKIM, and DMARC due to domain being registered by attacker with proper DNS records configured, making it appear legitimate.

indicators: Sender IP 198.51.100.45 not present in corporate mail system IPs
Domain financedevops.com newly registered (less than 2 months old)
Email contains base64 encoded URL parameters to evade simple pattern matching
Mismatch between sender display name 'Finance Department' and actual domain financedevops.com
Unusual external domain used to impersonate internal finance
examples.detection_method: Correlation of email sender domain registration age and IP reputation; SPF, DKIM, DMARC validation anomalies; detection of base64-encoded URL parameters in email body; alert on emails requesting wire transfers or sensitive financial info from external domains; user education to verify with known contacts via alternate channels.
